messages:
kevin: Hey infra — noticed GH Actions sometimes fires `atlantis apply` while ArgoCD is still reconciling. Result: apply completes but argocd immediately overrides and secret bootstrap intermittently fails. Anyone else run into this?
sarah: Yep, saw 2 failures this morning on payment-service. Atlantis apply returned 0 but next argocd sync reprovisioned the old secret. I grabbed the atlantis webhook id: a1b2c3d4.
infra-bot: [alert] deploy-checker: app=payment-service requeued sync (in-progress hooks).
olivia: My guess: the GH Action workflow doesn't verify ArgoCD app health before calling `atlantis apply`. We should add a preflight step that polls ArgoCD app status and waits for `Healthy` (or `Synced`) before apply. Quick example step to add:
```
- name: wait-for-argocd
  run: |
    for i in $(seq 1 12); do
      status=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ARGO_TOKEN" https://argocd.example.com/api/v1/applications/payment-service | jq -r .status.health.status)
      if [ "$status" = "Healthy" ]; then echo "argocd healthy"; exit 0; fi
      sleep 5
    done
    echo "timeout waiting for argocd" >&2
    exit 1
```
michael: That'd help but two cautions: 1) token needs proper scope (api.read) and 2) polling in GH Actions can extend CI timeouts; maybe keep short retry window. Also watch for argocd API rate limits.
kevin: As an alternative we could have ArgoCD POST to a small semaphore endpoint when sync completes and GH Actions wait on that signal instead of polling. More work to build the semaphore but less brittle/polling.
sarah: For immediate fix I'll add the poll step with a 60s timeout and a `SKIP_ARGO_CHECK` env var so we can bypass on emergency infra-only runs. I'll open a PR against infra repo.
olivia: Another pattern to consider longer-term: ArgoCD writes a short-lived "sync-in-progress" key to our S3/Dynamo lock namespace during hooks. GH Actions and Atlantis check that key before apply. Keeps things decoupled from CI network rules but couples infra.
michael: Or invert ordering: only allow atlantis apply after argocd post-sync webhook triggers a GitHub workflow dispatch. That needs repo-permissions wiring and could be trickier for multi-app PRs.
sarah: I'll put up a small PR with the poll step + docs and default timeout=60s. Will link here when opened. Assigning to me to implement.
kevin: thanks all. if the flaky behavior continues after this change we'll reconvene and prototype a semaphore. :thumbsup:

PR (wip): https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/412
